k: A TVA device that opens doors through time
st: Loki uses a TemPad to flee the TVA with Sylvie to Lamentis-1, where it runs out of power and breaks.
Sylvie brings another TemPad into the Void, and Mobius uses it to get back to the TVA.
Sylvie turns her back on the TVA, keeping He Who Remains's TemPad for herself.
Reset as Dr. A.D. Doug, Ouroboros builds Loki a TemPad using the TVA Handbook.
Wade steals Mr. Paradox's TemPad to visit Logan's grave and search the multiverse for another Logan.

k: TVA devices that wipe out branched timelines
st: TVA Minutemen drop reset charges to wipe out branched timelines and keep the Sacred Timeline on course.
A Loki variant steals charges from murdered Minutemen and sends them across the Sacred Timeline, branching it.
General Dox's loyalists set off reset charges that destroy most of the new branched timelines.
TVA Minutemen slow and prune variants with time sticks, and Renslayer prunes Loki with one.
Sylvie prunes herself with one to follow Loki into the Void.
Enchanted by Sylvie, Hunter X-5 prunes Ravonna Renslayer with a time stick.

k: A collar that keeps TVA prisoners in line
st: The TVA collars the arrested Loki, and a remote snaps him back whenever he tries to run.

k: An evacuation ship on a doomed moon
st: Loki and Sylvie fight their way toward the ark to escape Lamentis-1, but a meteor destroys it.

k: The TVA's guide to time and its tools
st: Miss Minutes and Renslayer drop the TVA Handbook to a young Victor Timely in 1868 Chicago.
Reset as Dr. A.D. Doug, Ouroboros builds a TemPad from the copy Loki kept.
Back at the TVA, Ouroboros writes a new TVA Handbook with Timely as co-author.

k: The machine that weaves the Sacred Timeline
st: Flooded by branching timelines, the TVA's Temporal Loom nears failure as Ouroboros races to fix it.
The Loom explodes; reliving the moment, Loki destroys it himself and holds the branching timelines together.

k: A device to let the Loom handle endless branches
st: Ouroboros and Victor Timely build the Throughput Multiplier to save the overloaded Temporal Loom.
Timely is spaghettified before he can launch it, and in Loki's later tries the Loom still fails.

k: A device that pulls someone out of the time stream
st: At the Temporal Loom, Mobius uses Ouroboros's Temporal Aura Extractor to pull a time-slipping Loki back.

k: A TVA machine built to erase a whole universe
st: Mr. Paradox readies a Time Ripper to speed up the death of Deadpool's universe.
Cassandra Nova tries to use it to end every timeline, until Wade and Logan destroy it together.

k: The Book of the Damned, a corrupting spellbook
st: Agatha Harkness keeps the Darkhold in her basement lair and learns from it that Wanda is the Scarlet Witch.
After Westview, Wanda studies the Darkhold in a remote cabin, hearing her sons cry for help.
Corrupted by it, Wanda dreamwalks across the multiverse and hunts America Chavez for her power.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
The sorceress Sara destroys Wanda's copy, and Strange takes a dead universe's copy to dreamwalk.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Wanda brings down Mount Wundagore, destroying every copy of the Darkhold across the multiverse.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A spellbook, the antithesis of the Darkhold
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
st: America Chavez and a Strange variant race for the Book of Vishanti in the space between universes.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Wanda appears and destroys the book just as Strange, America and Christine reach it.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A Wakandan suit with vibranium wings
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Bucky brings Sam a Wakandan case holding a new suit with vibranium wings, and Sam flies it as Captain America.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam wears it as Captain America against Serpent, the Leader's pilots and the red Hulk.

k: The Wilsons' fishing boat in Louisiana
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Sam fails to get a bank loan to save his family's fishing boat, which his sister Sarah plans to sell.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sam, Bucky and the Delacroix locals fix the boat up together.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: The new Captain America's own uniform
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Walker wears his own Captain America uniform until he loses the title; Valentina gives him a U.S. Agent suit.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Walker suits up as U.S. Agent on Valentina's jobs and with the team he names the Thunderbolts.

k: A shield Walker forges from scrap and medals
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: After losing Captain America's shield, Walker builds his own from scrap metal and his war medals.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Walker fights with his shield beside the outcasts he names the Thunderbolts.

k: A new metal found on Celestial Island
st: Adamantium is found on Celestial Island; Serpent steals the first refined samples, and Sam recovers them.
After Japan and the US nearly go to war over the island, a treaty to share adamantium is ratified.
The bounty hunter Paladin shoots Vision with adamantium rounds, mortally wounding him.

k: Pills that keep President Ross's heart going
st: Samuel Sterns's pills keep President Ross's failing heart going, but they secretly dose him with gamma radiation.

k: A failsafe built to shut down the Sentry
st: When Bob turns on Valentina, Mel stops him with a failsafe kill switch, and the Void breaks loose.

k: Tony Stark's glasses with a tactical AI
st: Nick Fury gives Peter the glasses Tony left him, which command the E.D.I.T.H. AI and Stark's drones.
Peter hands control to Quentin Beck, who plans to use E.D.I.T.H.'s drones for his illusions.
In London, Peter takes control of E.D.I.T.H. back and stops Beck's drone attack.
Beck's team hides drones and projectors inside the Elemental attacks, and MJ finds a projector in the debris.
Beck turns Stark's armed drones on London, until Peter fights through them and takes back control.

k: A caped suit with a glass dome helmet
st: Mysterio arrives to fight the Elementals in a caped suit and a glass dome helmet.
The suit turns out to be a costume made by Beck's team, which Beck wears again for his London attack.

k: A black suit to hide Spider-Man's identity
st: Nick Fury has a black stealth suit made for Peter in Europe, and Ned dubs it the Night Monkey suit.
After Beck's illusions leave Peter stranded in the Netherlands, a prison warden takes the suit.

k: A Venetian glass necklace Peter buys for MJ
st: In Venice, Peter buys MJ a black dahlia necklace of Venetian glass and waits for the right moment.
Broken in the chaos of Beck's attack, it reaches MJ in London, and she likes it even more.
MJ still wears the broken necklace as the world learns Peter is Spider-Man.

k: A relic box that holds a dangerous spell
st: Strange seals his corrupted memory spell inside the Macchina di Kadavus.
Peter takes the box from Strange and traps him in the Mirror Dimension.
The Green Goblin blows it apart with a pumpkin bomb, setting the spell loose.

k: Treatments Peter builds for the displaced villains
st: At Happy's apartment, Peter uses Stark tech to cure Otto Octavius, until the Goblin turns on him.
The three Peters build new cures and use them on the villains at the Statue of Liberty.

k: A device that keeps the Hulk suppressed
st: Bruce Banner keeps the Hulk down with an inhibitor, and Peter builds one of his own to rein in his new powers.
Jean Grey strips Bruce's inhibitor off, and Peter stops her with a universal inhibitor MJ helped finish.

k: An unsent letter reintroducing Peter to MJ
st: Peter writes MJ a letter to reintroduce himself but never sends it, and the telepath learns about her from it.
MJ finds the letter, and Peter tells her the truth and that he loves her.

k: Laura Barton's watch, lost in the Compound ruins
st: Salvaged from the Avengers Compound ruins, the watch is at a black market auction until the Tracksuit Mafia steal it.
Laura traces its tracking signal to Maya Lopez's apartment.
Clint gets the watch back and returns it to Laura on Christmas Day.

k: The aid Clint wears for his damaged hearing
st: Maya Lopez breaks Clint's hearing aid in a fight, and after escaping he and Kate get it fixed.
Arishem sends the ten Eternals to Earth aboard the Domo in 5000 BC.
After the Emergence is stopped, Thena, Druig and Makkari leave Earth on it to warn other Eternals.

k: An ancient sword tied to Dane Whitman's family
st: Dane Whitman opens an old case holding the Ebony Blade, and an unseen voice asks if he is ready.

k: Ancient rings that grant godly power
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Xu Wenwu finds the Ten Rings a thousand years ago and builds an empire, setting them aside only for his family.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Dying, Wenwu passes the rings to Shang-Chi, and at Kamar-Taj they are found to be sending out a beacon.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: Two pendants Ying Li left her children
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: The Ten Rings attack Shang-Chi on a San Francisco bus and steal the pendant his mother gave him.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Wenwu takes Xialing's matching pendant and uses both to reveal a map to Ta Lo.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: Armor and weapons made from dragon scales
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: In Ta Lo, Shang-Chi and his friends are given outfits and weapons made from the Great Protector's scales.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Katy fires a dragon-scale arrow into the Dweller-in-Darkness as the heroes slay it.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A golden scarab that leads to Ammit's tomb
st: Steven Grant unknowingly has the scarab that Arthur Harrow needs to find Ammit's tomb.
Marc Spector loses the scarab to Harrow, who uses it in his search for the tomb.

k: Armor that Khonshu's avatar can summon
st: Steven's other self takes over and becomes a cloaked warrior in Khonshu's armor to kill a jackal.
Steven summons a suit of his own, a white three-piece suit with a mask.
Freed from his ushabti, Khonshu restores their suits, and Marc and Steven fight Harrow and Ammit.

k: A stone figure that imprisons a god
st: The Ennead imprison Khonshu in an ushabti for turning back the night sky.
Layla finds Khonshu's ushabti and breaks it, freeing him.

k: A stone figure holding the goddess Ammit
st: Steven finds Ammit's ushabti inside Alexander the Great's body in her tomb.
Harrow's followers take it from Marc's body, and Harrow smashes it at the pyramids to free Ammit.

k: The cane Arthur Harrow uses to judge souls
st: Harrow judges people's souls with his cane, which grows more powerful once he frees Ammit.

k: A ship that carries the dead through the Duat
st: Disguised as a psychiatric hospital, Taweret's boat carries Marc and Steven through the Duat to the Gates of Osiris.

k: The scales that weigh the hearts of the dead
st: Taweret weighs Marc and Steven's hearts on the Scales of Justice, which balance only after Steven is lost.

k: A red gem that gives its wielder power
st: After Ulysses Bloodstone dies, his gem is set in a captured monster, the prize of a hunt in Bloodstone Manor's maze.
Elsa pulls it from Ted, and Verussa uses it to force Jack Russell into his werewolf form.
After Verussa dies, Elsa takes the manor and the Bloodstone.

k: A god-killing sword that corrupts its wielder
st: The Necrosword calls to Gorr, who kills his god Rapu with it and vows to kill all gods.
Thor and Jane destroy the Necrosword at Eternity's altar, freeing Gorr from its hold.
Thor impales Zeus with his own thunderbolt in Omnipotence City, and Valkyrie steals it.
Thor uses the thunderbolt to give the Asgardian children his power against Gorr's monsters.

k: The Guardians of the Galaxy's new spaceship
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
st: Kevin Bacon learns about Quill's past from Kraglin aboard the Guardians' new ship, the Bowie.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
The Guardians fly the Bowie to Orgocorp and Counter-Earth to find the code that can save Rocket.

k: An Orgocorp kill switch hidden inside Rocket
st: After Adam Warlock wounds Rocket, a kill switch Orgocorp put in him stops the med-packs from healing him.
Quill and Groot take the override code from Theel's body, and Quill shuts the kill switch off.

k: The High Evolutionary's lab that is secretly a ship
st: On Counter-Earth, the High Evolutionary's Arête Laboratories complex lifts off as a spaceship.
Kraglin fires on it with Knowhere, and it is destroyed after the Guardians free the children and animals.

k: A golden bangle from Kamala's family
One of the two legendary Quantum Bands
st: In 1947, Aisha leaves the bangle with her daughter Sana before the Clandestine Najma kills her.
Sana sends it to Kamala, and it unlocks her powers; it later glows as she swaps places with Carol Danvers.
Kamala wears her Band as the Marvels chase Dar-Benn across space.
Dar-Benn steals Kamala's Band and wears both Bands, which destroys her.
Kamala reclaims both Bands and helps Monica close the rupture they leave behind.
Dar-Benn finds the second Quantum Band and uses it to rip open jump points.
Wearing both Bands destroys Dar-Benn, and Kamala reclaims them.
Dar-Benn, the Kree's new leader, fights the Marvels with an Accuser's war hammer.

k: The costume Kamala makes for herself
st: Kamala makes a costume from a gift from her mother and a mask Bruno made, and takes the name Ms. Marvel.
Kamala wears her costume as she teams up with Carol and Monica as the Marvels.

k: Custom outfits from the hero tailor Luke Jacobson
st: Nikki and Pug get Jen custom superhero outfits from Luke Jacobson, a tailor to heroes.

k: Devices that stop a Hulk from transforming
st: Emil Blonsky is paroled wearing an inhibitor, which his parole officer later finds broken.
Damage Control makes Jen wear an inhibitor, and she destroys it at Intelligencia's event.
The Wrecking Crew attack Jen to steal a sample of her blood for an anonymous client, and fail.
Josh Miller steals a sample for HulkKing, who is Todd Phelps, and Todd injects it to become a Hulk.
The Wrecking Crew attack Jen with stolen Asgardian construction tools, but she overpowers them.

k: A necklace with Wakandan power inside
st: At Troy, B'Kai, posing as Memnon, talks Helen into giving up her necklace and brings it home to Wakanda.

k: A dragon statue holding a piece of vibranium
st: In 1400, Wakandan agent Basha steals the head of a K'un-Lun dragon statue that holds a piece of vibranium.
Jorani pulls the vibranium out with the Iron Fist and takes the statue's head home to K'un-Lun.

k: A machine that can find vibranium
st: The CIA uses a vibranium detector, built by an MIT student, to find vibranium under the Atlantic.
Wakanda puts a vibranium detector on a ship to lure Namor's army to the surface.
At MIT, Riri Williams flies a homemade suit of armor to escape the FBI with Shuri, and the chase wrecks it.
In Wakanda, Riri builds an Iron Man-style suit for the battle, then leaves it behind when she returns to MIT.
Expelled from MIT, Riri takes a new suit home to Chicago, until Zeke Stane tears it apart.
Riri builds a new suit in Gary's garage from the car they restored, and Zelma powers it with magic.

k: A new Black Panther suit made for Shuri
st: Shuri dons a new Black Panther suit after taking the herb, and leads Wakanda's attack on Talokan.

k: Armor Shuri makes for the Dora Milaje
st: Shuri gives Okoye the Midnight Angel armor, and Okoye brings Aneka into a second suit for the battle.
Namor leads Talokan's warriors with his spear, and fights Shuri on a beach until he yields.

k: A demonic cloak that gives Parker power
st: After a failed robbery, Mephisto gives Parker Robbins a hooded cloak of dark power.
Riri tears the cloak off Parker in their final fight, leaving him powerless.

k: DNA collected from the heroes of the Battle of Earth
st: Fury digs the Harvest, DNA from the Battle of Earth, out of a Finnish grave marked with his own name.
Fury hands it to Gravik, and both Gravik and G'iah, disguised as Fury, take its powers.

k: A machine that gives Skrulls enhanced DNA
st: Gravik's machine gives Skrulls powers from enhanced DNA; he tests it on himself, and G'iah uses it too.

k: Brooms the coven flies on the Witches' Road
st: Chased by the Salem Seven, the coven flies makeshift broomsticks until the Road pulls them back down.

k: A device Cassie builds to contact the Quantum Realm
st: Cassie builds a device to reach the Quantum Realm, and its signal pulls her family into the realm.

k: The power core of Kang's ship
st: Years earlier, Janet helps Kang rebuild his power core, then enlarges it with Pym Particles so he cannot use it.
Scott shrinks into the core and takes it back for Kang, who breaks their deal.
Janet fixes it to open a way home, and Scott and Hope throw Kang into it, destroying it.
Hope, Janet and Hank steal Lord Krylar's ship as they flee his city.
M.O.D.O.K. destroys the ship with Hank aboard, while Kang captures Janet.

n: Look Out for the Little Guy
st: Scott's memoir about his Avengers days makes him a local celebrity, and he signs copies around San Francisco.
Cassie fights Kang's forces in a size-changing suit of her own.
The team flies the Excelsior to face Galactus, then wrecks its FTL drive at a neutron star to escape; Franklin is born aboard.
The Fantastic Four travel around New York in their flying Fantasticar.

k: The craft Galactus's herald rides through space
st: The Silver Surfer rides her board through space for Galactus and brings it to Earth to warn of his coming.
Shalla-Bal drives Galactus through the portal herself and vanishes with him.
Galactus's vast ship devours a planet as the team arrives, and they are captured and brought before him.

k: Bridges built to move Earth out of reach
st: Reed's teleportation bridges are built worldwide; the Surfer wrecks most, and the last one sends Galactus away.

k: A mask held by a cloaked stranger
st: Four years later, Sue finds baby Franklin with a man in a green cloak holding a metal mask.
